source.name: Truist media release: Truist and the Atlanta Braves Announce Truist Park as New Name of SunTrust Park
source.quote: Truist Financial Corporation (NYSE: TFC) and the Atlanta Braves today announced that SunTrust Park will be renamed Truist Park as a continuation of its naming rights partnership

note: Arena naming rights: Truist Park. Start date unknown: the record said 2026 (the season it was recorded), its source is from 2020-01-14.
